description: How tools/extract_legacy.py partitions the 18.6.6 tree. Every inventoried file lands in exactly one bucket; the decision and the reason are recorded per file in EXTRACTION.json. Categories are those of reference-file-inventory.json.

buckets.app: Copied into <dest>/app: the code that runs, and the configuration it reads from ROOT. Versioned in Git.
buckets.data: Not copied into app. Listed in <dest>/data-manifest.json with path and SHA256; hydrated into the tree at container start from a data mount or EU object storage. Never versioned in Git.
buckets.client_material: Real-subject client work (publication-safety-report.md Result 3). Excluded unless --demos all.
buckets.debris: Release-process artefacts, superseded generations, backups, Windows launchers, prose documentation. Stays in the archive.

demo_library.note: Demo seeds, loaders, catalogs and registries are code-like and go to app. Binary payloads (databases, exports, reports, images) go to data. demo_library/canonical is real-subject client material.

root_state_files.note: Mutable application state shipped inside the archive. Excluded from app (the reference creates and migrates them on first use); listed in the data manifest as class state_seed so a demo-populated starting state can be restored deliberately.
